features_verified.feature: Phase 3: USB Auto-detect Fix (Model-based Device ID)
features_verified.details: Device preferences keyed by device_model (ro.product.model) instead of serial. KEY TEST PASSED: Save prefs for model SM-S928B with skip_prompt=true, then POST device-event with DIFFERENT serial but same model — returns auto_launched (not prompt_needed).
POST /api/dhu/start only accepts borderless+alwaysOnTop. /api/dhu/resize endpoint removed (returns 404). No mode toggle visible in UI. AndroidAutoPanel simplified to just launch/stop.

TurnArrow component uses thick pointed chevron path with solid fill (#152118 inactive, #2D8C4E active). Never hollow/transparent. SVG filter glow applied when active. Left arrow points left, right arrow points right.
